facts.fact: Binary classes SNIa and NotSNIa; fully connected layer with two outputs
Trained only on SEDM spectra from the P60 (R~100, 3800-9150 A)
Phases of the dataset fall within -20 to +30 d; reliable range stated as within +-20 d of maximum (a property of the data, no deployment restriction stated)
Recommended cuts: score>0.6 & sigma<0.3 (FPR~0.5%) or score>0.8 & sigma<0.275 (FPR 0 on validation/test); stricter cut appropriate for live TNS reporting
SEDM resolution cannot separate SN Ia subtypes except clear-cut cases
Main false-positive contaminants are stripped-envelope SNe, especially SN Ic-like; SN 2018cne officially classified SN Ic by BTS; SN 2020eyj officially SN Ia but later Ibn-like

Fully deployed from 2021 April 15 with automatic reporting of confident SN Ia classifications and redshifts to TNS; first report for SN 2021ijb ~10 min after exposure; initial threshold 0.9, planned relaxation to >0.8 & sigma<0.275
TNS classification report reference 'SNIascore. 2021, TNS Classification Report, 9385'
A CCSN subtype classifier (Sharma et al.) in progress

seeds.contribution: a second automated SEDM classifier whose TNS reports would be model annotation for CC classes; as of v2 real-time TNS reporting had not started
